text:
[LSTR.3.2] String ordering is lexicographic by codepoint value.
This is not locale-aware ordering; it sorts by Unicode scalar
value, which corresponds to UTF-8 byte ordering for any
well-formed pair.

idris.name: iret_7_5__cmp_str
idris.note: A String compared with a String: the orderings by this clause's order, `==` and `!=` by [LSTR.3.1]'s equality; a `null` right operand propagates; anything else is ill-typed, a trap.

idris.name: iret_7_5__str_order
idris.note: The six comparisons on two texts: `<` and `>` this clause's order, `<=` and `>=` the order or [LSTR.3.1]'s equality, `==` and `!=` the equality.

idris.name: lstr_3_2__cp_cmp
idris.note: Two codepoints compared by scalar value, structurally, so the order's laws are proved by induction: the clause's 'by codepoint value', one codepoint at a time.

idris.name: lstr_3_2__cp_cmp_flip
idris.note: LT one way is GT the other.

idris.name: lstr_3_2__cp_cmp_flip_gt
idris.note: GT one way is LT the other.

idris.name: lstr_3_2__cp_cmp_refl
idris.note: A codepoint compared with itself is EQ.

idris.name: lstr_3_2__fixture_claims
idris.note: The fixtures' claims executed on their texts: `a` above `Z` and `Y` not (codepoint order, not alphabetical), `é` above `z`, `ab` below `abc` while `abc` and `abd` are not, `Z` above `M` and `A` not. The astral codepoint above every BMP one is run in Main.idr.

idris.name: lstr_3_2__lt
idris.note: `a < b` on texts: lexicographic by codepoint value, the empty text below every nonempty one so a proper prefix sorts first; not locale-aware. The clause's remark that this is UTF-8 byte order for a well-formed pair is not transcribed: the model has codepoints, not bytes.

idris.name: lstr_3_2__lt_asym
idris.note: A text below another is not above it, for every pair.

idris.name: lstr_3_2__lt_at
idris.note: One step of the order, the decision on the heads taken first: a smaller head decides true, a greater false, equal heads leave it to the tails.

idris.name: lstr_3_2__lt_total
idris.note: Two texts that are not equal ([LSTR.3.1]) are ordered one way or the other: a total order on distinct texts.

idris.name: lstr_3_2__lt_trans
idris.note: The order is transitive, for every three texts.

idris.name: lstr_3_2__prefix_sorts_first
idris.note: A proper prefix is below every text it is a prefix of, for every text, codepoint and continuation.
